"''Call it in.|Beak and Hazram Namir while on Hoth|''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]''}} The '''''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier''', also known simply as the '''Imperial assault carrier''', was a variant of the [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] used by the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. ==Characteristics== [[File:ImperialFreighter-CGSWG.png|thumb|250px|left|The Gozanti-class Assualt Carrier was an alternate configuration of the standard Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser (pictured).]] The ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier, also denoted as the Imperial assault carrier, was a variant and alternative configuration of the [[Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser|Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser]], which itself was a converted version of the civilian [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class armed transport]]. The ''Gozanti''-class Assault [[Carrier]] was upgraded with a reinforced [[hull]] and more powerful [[repulsorlift]] [[engine]]s that allowed its four ventral [[magnet]]ic docking claws to carry a cargo of four [[All Terrain Defense Pod]]s, two [[All Terrain Armored Transport]]s, or four [[All Terrain Scout Transport]]s, or carry four [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] craft, similar to the standard Imperial ''Gozanti''-class cruiser. One model of the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier was armed with two twin [[laser cannon]] [[turret]]s, both located in the rear dorsal and ventral parts of the ship. It had three engines and a dorsal [[rectenna]]. Another model seen used by the Empire{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} and by [[Moff]] [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]] possessed heavier [[armor]], more weapons, and a cargo bay. ==History== ===Early Rebellion=== [[File:Gozanti-class_Cruiser_XWM.png|thumb|left|200px|A ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier above Coruscant.]] The ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier was introduced by the [[Galactic Empire]] by the [[time]] of the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]]. The [[Spectres]], a group of insurgents headquartered on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] [[Mission to steal Imperial weapons|stole]] illegal [[T-7 ion disruptor rifle]]s in [[5 BBY]] to prevent the Empire from getting control of them. After a skirmish on [[Garel]], the Spectres rendezvoused with the criminal and arms [[smuggler]] [[Cikatro Vizago]] to sell the weapons. Unknown to the group, however, [[Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus]] became aware of the exchange and used a ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier to deploy four AT-DP [[walker]]s, then deploying from the ship himself with a [[squad]] of [[stormtrooper]]s. After the carrier deployed the Imperial forces, it proceeded to leave the area. Eventually, Imperial forces were pushed back and defeated. ===Galactic Civil War=== In [[3 BBY]], during the then-unofficial [[Galactic Civil War]], a ''Gozanti-''class Assault Carrier of the more heavily armored variant was present at the [[Coruscant Eastern Spaceport|Eastern Spaceport]] on [[Coruscant]]. Shortly after, another was docked at [[Port Steergard]].{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}} ====Lothal Skirmish==== Shortly after the [[Battle of Garel]] during 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], a [[Lothal senatorial convoy|senatorial convoy]] of the [[Royal Alderaan Civil Fleet]] arrived on Lothal, with three [[Sphyrna-class Hammerhead corvette|''Sphyrna''-class Hammerhead corvettes]] being ordered to land in the [[city]] of [[Jalath]] for inspection. There, Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Yogar Lyste]] arrived with stormtrooper forces with [[gravity lock]]s to secure the ships, while a ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier deployed two AT-AT walkers, including [[AT-AT 36]], to provide perimeter security and prevent rebel forces from stealing the trio of [[corvette]]s, as [[Alderaanian]] ships were infamous for being stolen by rebel forces. Eventually, rebel forces managed to defeat the Imperials, and successfully stole all three ships.{{Rebels|A Princess on Lothal}} ====Mission to Agamar==== A year later in [[2 BBY]], members of the Spectres [[Mission to Agamar (2 BBY)|ventured]] to [[Agamar]] in order to retrieve weapons from [[Unidentified DH-Omni Support Vessel (Agamar)|a]] downed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Dual Hemisphere-Omni Support Vessel|DH-Omni Support Vessel]] from the [[Clone Wars]]. However, the [[garrison]] of [[battle droid]]s onboard the ship had survived, as their leader, the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|ST-series super tactical droid]] [[General]] [[Kalani]], had disregarded the shutdown command that was issued from [[Mustafar]] at the end of the war. After capturing the Spectres and forcing them to battle his [[droid]]s, they eventually won. Soon after the Empire arrived, including two ''Gozanti''-class assault carriers carrying two All Terrain Defense Pods and two [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|All Terrain Armored Transport Prototypes]] respectively. Having been forced to ally with the droids, the Spectres made their escape in [[Phantom II|one]] [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], and Kalani and his remaining forces making theirs in another after having taken down one AT-AT/P.''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' - "[[The Last Battle]]" ====Battle of Hoth==== [[File:Gozanti-Hoth.png|thumb|right|270px|One of several ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers deployed on Hoth.]] In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' at the [[Battle of Hoth]], Imperial [[General]] [[Maximilian Veers]] used several ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers to deploy the [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Galactic Civil War)|walkers]] of [[Blizzard Force]] instead of [[Y-85 Titan dropship]]s, as he was wary that enemy [[starfighter]]s would swarm the dropships before they had a chance to reach their landing zone.[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] The carriers were initially spotted by [[Rebel trooper]] and [[61st Mobile Infantry|Twilight Company]] member [[Roja]], who was posted at Echo Base's [[Perimeter Outpost Delta]]. His squadmate [[Beak (individual)|Beak]] identified the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers and deduced that they were bringing walkers to deploy on the surface of Hoth. [[First Sergeant]] [[Hazram Namir]] ordered Beak to report their presence as a result. ====Skirmish on Vardos==== After the [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] at the climactic [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]] and the launch of his final command, [[Operation: Cinder]], Imperial forces led by ISB [[Admiral]] [[Garrick Versio]] and [[Moff]] [[Derrek Raythe]] initiated the operation on the loyal Imperial world of [[Vardos]]. The operation called for the destruction of Imperial worlds, in a self-destructive scheme to tear down the remnants of the Empire, as Palpatine believed it did not deserve to outlive him. Early on, as the operation's [[climate disruption array]]s began altering the climate and creating catastrophic storms, ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers were present in the capital city of [[Kestro City|Kestro]], with one deploying an AT-AT near the [[Archive]]. An ensuing [[Skirmish on Vardos|skirmish]] erupted when two members of the [[Imperial Special Forces]] [[Inferno Squad]] defected and hijacked the AT-AT in a bid to help evacuate civilians. ====Battle of Theed==== {{Quote|Imperial protocol is to jump away to a safe location. Those ships are headed straight for Theed. They're going to attack the city.|Alliance forces observing ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers and other ships evacuate the ''Torment''|}} [[File:Gozanti-Naboo.png|thumb|left|270px|One of at least two ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers during the Battle of Theed.]] In accordance with Operation: Cinder, [[Captain]] [[Lerr Duvat]] from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Torment]]'' deployed the climate disruption arrays above Emperor Palpatine's [[homeworld]] of [[Naboo]]. The [[Battle of Theed]] began when members of the [[Naboo Royal Space Fighter Corps]] and the Rebel Alliance engaged the ''Torment'' in orbit and destroyed the arrays. After a [[Space warfare|naval engagement]] resulted in the destruction of the ''Torment'', several landing forces launched from the [[Star Destroyer]] and headed towards the capital city [[Theed]]. The Imperial contingent included at least two ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers that deployed AT-ATs in the center of the city. With fierce fighting occuring in the streets and starfighter combat above the city, the AT-ATs advanced towards the [[Theed Royal Palace]] in an effort to defeat the Alliance forces. An ion burst from the palace, however, thwarted Imperial efforts as it disabled all of their equipment and forced an Imperial surrender. ===New Republic Era=== [[File:MissionGozanti.png|thumb|right|240px|Din Djarin watches the ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carrier on Trask.]] Around [[9 ABY]], with the help of [[Din Djarin]], [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], [[Axe Woves]], and [[Koska Reeves]] infiltrated an up-armored ''Gozanti''-class cruiser transporting weapons. Intending to capture a weapons shipment, the warriors secured the cargo before taking the bridge and hijacking the ship. Djarin would depart their company after their successful mission. The fleet assembled by Kryze, by the time it was taken over by Woves and stationed on [[Plazir-15]], contained multiple up-armored ''Gozanti''-class Assault Carriers. The fleet returned to Kryze's possession when she defeated Woves in single combat,{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 22: Guns for Hire}} and was mobilized in the successful [[Liberation of Mandalore|mission]] to reclaim Mandalore.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}} ==Behind the scenes== ===Dimension discrepancies=== [[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season Two)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two]] supplied the length, width and height of the Gozanti-class Assault Carrier in feet (ft), as 210ft, 114ft, and 42ft respectively.[[The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian (Season Two)|''The Art of Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Two]] However, the canonical reference book, ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' established more precise measurements in meters and feet.
